jobs.txt:
Company: Doctolib
Title: AI Engineer Intern (x/f/m) - Paris
Location: Paris
Visa: 
Join a team of passionate and committed people working to improve healthcare. At Doctolib, our tech teams build products and features that improve the daily lives of healthcare professionals and patients. We work in feature teams within an agile environment, in close collaboration with Product, Design, Data Science, and Business teams. What you'll do We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to join our Tech team and contribute to the development of AI-powered features at Doctolib. You will work closely with experienced AI and software engineers to explore, prototype, evaluate, and improve AI-based solutions. This internship will give you the opportunity to gain practical experience across the different stages of an AI product, from experimentation to integration into a production environment. Your responsibilities will include: Contribute to the development of AI features and services under the guidance of experienced engineers Write Python code to support prototypes, experiments, evaluation tools, and backend components Experiment with large language models, prompting techniques, retrieval, and tool
